description: A high-intensity conditioning movement combining a squat, plank kick-out, chest-to-floor drop, and vertical jump.
setup: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and arms hanging naturally at your sides.
steps: Drop hips down and place both hands flat on the floor in front of your feet.
Jump or step feet back into a push up plank and lower chest to touch floor.
Press up, snap feet back toward hands into squat stance, and jump upward with hands overhead.
cues: Snap feet forward wide to land on flat feet
Exhale forcefully as you press off the ground and jump

mistakes.mistake: Sagging lower back as hips kick out into plank
mistakes.fix: Squeeze glutes and abs to keep spine rigid throughout plank transitions

mistakes.mistake: Landing stiff-legged on toe balls after the jump
mistakes.fix: Land softly with knees slightly bent to absorb impact through legs

rep_standard: Chest touches floor at bottom, both feet leave floor with arms clapping or reaching overhead at top
